reviews.comment: Prof. Guermond is a great lecturer and makes abstract PDE generalizations understandable, but there is so much material that you will be behind unless you read the lecture notes before class. Tests and homework are well-structured, but Guermond will frequently forget to open Canvas assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were mostly just working through problems and not many deep explanations of things. Professor Guermond is clearly very good at mathematics but he sometimes forgets that the class does not grasp things as thoroughly as he does. Tests will be curved as needed which is all but guaranteed.
Grading is real hard. Also he takes quiz every week which very very annoying. This subject is very difficult to pass.

He is great at explaining things very clearly, but make sure you ask questions during class, I got the impressions that office hours were just something he had to put on paper. Testsquizzes were long, but plenty of practice material. Didn't do great in the class, but would totally take him again.
